skygo --json state retention enable --data-dir $DATA --request-window 1h
retention-domain DOMAIN
server start
taskfile task.json success
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id retained --wait
job-id JOB
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
stdout '"marked": *1'
! skygo run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id retained
stderr 'result expired'
event-count 1
# A changed task still conflicts with its authorized binding after result expiry.
taskfile changed.json hold
! skygo run -f changed.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id retained
stderr 'already_exists'
event-count 1
# A new current-domain binding is deliberate new work, not an automatic retry.
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id deliberate-new --wait
event-count 2
calls PlanTask 0
calls SubmitJob 0
calls SubmitRetryJob 0
server stop
! stderr .
